text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- National Assembly ratifies agreement to link Iraq's power grid with neighbouring countries.
- Threats force United States to postpone a commemoration ceremony of American soldiers killed during the 1991 Gulf War.
- Iraq and Libya sign minutes of education and cultural cooperation.
(The above stories were also carried by IRAQ and QADISSIYA)
